topic: The night Elvis bought Graceland — he was 22 years old
script: Three years after driving a delivery truck in Memphis, Elvis Presley bought a mansion. It was March 1957. He was twenty-two years old. The price was one hundred two thousand, five hundred dollars. The house stood on a hill south of the city, built in 1939, and named for a woman called Grace. He kept the name. He moved his parents in. Vernon and Gladys Presley had raised their son in a two-room house in Tupelo, Mississippi, a house his father helped build. Now the family lived behind stone walls and white columns. Gladys lived there for little more than a year. Graceland was his home for twenty years. He died there in August 1977. Today he rests in its garden, beside his mother and father. Every year, hundreds of thousands of people walk up that hill. They come to see where a young man brought his family home.
